title: Vector plot
text: Plot vectors in space domain, 7 inputs, {Theta units} sets Unit of Theta input; {Select input types} sets the input port types Vabc, {Select reference frame} sets the reference frame for vectors Rotating Reference, {Alpha (phase-a) axis alignment} sets the dq reference frame, {Angle units} sets the unit of Angle and {Open plot at simulation start} sets the open vector plot at simulation start. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Vdq
ports.summary: Voltages in dq reference frame vector

ports.name: Idq
ports.summary: Currents in dq reference frame vector

params.name: Select input types
params.values: Input port types Vabc Iabc Theta (default) | Vdq Idq | Mag Angle

params.name: Select reference frame
params.values: Reference frame for vectors Rotating Reference Frame (default) | Stationary Reference Frame

params.name: Alpha (phase-a) axis alignment
params.values: dq reference frame alignment D-axis (default) | Q-axis

params.name: Theta units
params.values: Unit of Theta input Radians (default) | Degrees | Per-unit

params.name: Angle units
params.values: Unit of Angle input Radians (default) | Degrees | Per-unit

params.name: Open plot at simulation start
params.values: Open vector plot at simulation start on (default) | off
